# OpesCare

> OpesCare (https://opescare.com) is a free, bilingual (English and French) health service for Cameroon, operated by Opes Health Systems Sarl. It helps people find a medicine in stock at a nearby pharmacy, find blood products at blood banks, book an appointment with a provider, and browse the national health facility directory. It also gives patients a portable Health ID and a health record that clinicians read only with a recorded basis such as an appointment or consent grant.

Stock and blood availability are reported by facilities and timestamped; OpesCare never shows demo or estimated stock as live, so an empty result is a real answer. OpesCare is not an emergency service and does not sell insurance. Every page is available in French by adding `?lang=fr`.

## Facts

- [OpesCare facts](https://opescare.com/about/facts): citable definitions, key facts, modules, glossary and contact
- [Full description for language models](https://opescare.com/llms-full.txt): complete plain-Markdown description
- [About](https://opescare.com/about): what OpesCare is and where its data comes from
- [FAQ](https://opescare.com/faq): plain answers in English and French

## Services

- [Medicine finder](https://opescare.com/network/medicine-finder): pharmacies reporting a medicine in stock, nearest first
- [Blood finder](https://opescare.com/network/blood-finder): blood products by type at blood banks
- [Lab test finder](https://opescare.com/network/lab-test-finder): facilities offering a lab test
- [Imaging finder](https://opescare.com/network/imaging-finder): facilities offering an imaging exam
- [Facility directory](https://opescare.com/care-map): searchable register of hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and laboratories in Cameroon
- [Emergency facilities](https://opescare.com/care-map/emergency): facilities with emergency services
